Text 'Список некоторых слов и образцов речи, собранных на Берегу Маклая в 1876—1877 гг.', printed pp. 158-163 (Bai column pp. 161-163), commentary pp. 402-403. sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. The Бай (Bai) column is a c. 60-item wordlist (items 1-76 with gaps) in Latin script with no stress/accent marks at all (checked page images); the only mention of stress in the whole dialect section is editorial footnote 6* to the Bongu list, 'В рукописи далее ударения отсутствуют' (stress marks absent in the manuscript from here on). Editors' note 1 (V. I. Belikov) equates Бай with the language Dumun.

sources.citation: Z'graggen, J. A. 1980. A comparative word list of the Rai Coast languages, Madang Province, Papua New Guinea. Pacific Linguistics D-30. Canberra: ANU.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No stress/accent statement anywhere; Dumun (Bx, the language Bai is equated with) had only a short list and is 'discarded in the remainder of this volume'; Miklukho-Maklaj (1951) cited only as a source of 'words and occasional notes'. Nothing on Bai.

sources.citation: Miklucho-Maclay, N. von. 1882. Papua-Dialekte der Maclay-Küste in Neu-Guinea (with 'Grammatische Bemerkungen', prepared with Herr Grube). In G. von der Gabelentz & A. B. Meyer, Beiträge zur Kenntniss der melanesischen, mikronesischen und papuanischen Sprachen, 491-510. Leipzig: Hirzel.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Covers six other Maclay-Coast varieties only (Gorendu/Bongu/Gumbu, Bogati, Bili-Bili, Mitebog, Englam-Mana, Maragum-Mana); Bai is not included. The 'Grammatische Bemerkungen' give a Lautbestand and pronunciation notes but say nothing about Betonung/accent.
